provenance.generation: Real current/original v1 to_dict serializers and atomic _write_manifest writers; synthetic result states.
provenance.limits: Synthetic native/Robin bytes, not physical evidence. Pi paths replace temporary paths only after preparation. No hardware execution.

blockers: profile prepares an artifact but cannot perform the physical flash

instructions.text: Robin_nano.bin contains the verified Robin transformation. Preserve its native klipper.bin and transformation evidence for recovery. KACE has not copied it to an SD card or verified installation.

Manual procedure: copy the already transformed Robin_nano.bin to the controller's SD card, safely eject it, and restart only the printer with that card inserted. Do not run update_mks_robin.py again or use make flash. KACE does not perform these actions.

After completing the manual installation, reconnect the original controller through the chosen connection and select Verify MCU in KACE. A downloaded file or a visible USB adapter alone does not verify the installed Klipper build.
